progression.narrative: The performance opens on A3 and dwells most on E in Feyli. Zirafkand (0:10.3) introduces A, centred on E. The line peaks at E4 (342.6 Hz) at 0:53.5. It closes on the tonic (E4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → A2 → A2).
